correctness.rationale: For all b>1/2 the fixed point and branch matrix are calculated exactly. Six strict affine inequalities for visits 0,1,2 reduce to a bounded polygon; integration gives the two area formulas. The nonstandard inverse-trapping assertion follows from v-u<beta<2 alpha and u<beta/2, which imply the full inverse image of S3 remains in Q2. Induction then gives equality of all later survivor sets; det A=2 proves area halving. An explicit strict outside-quadrant inverse-image witness from S2 proves sharp onset, and exact A^T A=2I gives unique eternal survivor. Exact rational clipping at seven parameter choices corroborates each algebraic step without being mistaken for an all-n proof.

value.rationale: The source isolates a repelling fixed point whose transient residence statistics are absent from the qualitative eventual-exit theorem. Uniform exact area ratios, a genuine b=1 triangle/pentagon transition, a sharp start time of three, and a full first-exit law for a natural planar sampling distribution answer a nontrivial quantitative gap; the conclusion is not the determinant-two observation alone, because exact inverse trapping at the earliest iterate and exact first-region area require a global active-facet calculation.
